quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: for supernodes it can deliver whole racks of 'server + network + liquid cooling + rack + power supply' with scheduling, operations and storage; its intelligent computing network line includes a single-chip 102.4T switch and new-generation intelligent computing WAN products; its Lingxi intelligent computing solution has been deployed at scale in government cloud training/inference platforms, large-model training compute centres and medical research AI.

Unisplendour.why: Through subsidiary H3C it builds and sells AI servers, UniPoD supernode racks and data center switches into Chinese AI compute build-outs; server and network revenue rises with AI data center capex.
Unisplendour.evidence: Unisplendour investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-16-2026): the company's UniPoD S80000 series supernode products cover 32-card to 1024-card configurations, scaling to 16384 cards, compatible with multi-vendor CPU/GPU/NPU/DPU compute.
